department: School of Engineering & Technology - Applied Sciences
description: Rigorous mathematical foundations for computational engineering: linear algebra, multivariable calculus, differential equations, Fourier transforms, and Bayesian statistical distributions.

modules.moduleTitle: Linear Algebra & Matrix Decompositions
modules.topics: Vector spaces, linear independence, basis and dimension, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, Diagonalization, Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), Principal Component Analysis (PCA) foundations.
modules.practicalLabWork: MATLAB/Python numerical matrix factorizations, eigen-spectrum analysis.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain the geometric intuition of Eigenvalues and why SVD is used in data dimensionality reduction.

modules.moduleTitle: Differential Calculus & Vector Fields
modules.topics: Partial derivatives, Jacobian and Hessian matrices, Taylor series for multivariable functions, Lagrange multipliers for constrained optimization, Gradient vector fields, divergence and curl.
modules.practicalLabWork: Numerical gradient descent simulation and contour surface plotting in Python.
modules.vivaQuestions: How does the Hessian matrix determine local saddle points in non-convex optimization functions?

modules.moduleTitle: Ordinary & Partial Differential Equations
modules.topics: First and second order ODEs with constant coefficients, Euler-Cauchy equations, Laplace transforms and applications to circuit analysis, Heat equation, Wave equation, Laplace equation solutions.
modules.practicalLabWork: Numerical ODE solving with Runge-Kutta 4th order algorithms.
modules.vivaQuestions: Derive the Laplace transform of a unit step function and explain its utility in system transfer functions.

modules.moduleTitle: Probability Distributions & Random Variables
modules.topics: Axioms of probability, Conditional probability and Bayes theorem, Discrete (Binomial, Poisson) and Continuous (Gaussian Normal, Exponential) distributions, Central Limit Theorem, Joint probability density.
modules.practicalLabWork: Monte Carlo simulation of Poisson arrival rates and Central Limit convergence.
modules.vivaQuestions: State the Central Limit Theorem and prove why real-world noise defaults to a Gaussian distribution.

modules.moduleTitle: Statistical Inference & Hypothesis Testing
modules.topics: Point and interval estimation, Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Hypothesis testing: Null vs Alternative hypothesis, p-values, z-test, t-test, Chi-square test for independence, ANOVA.
modules.practicalLabWork: A/B test statistical significance calculator in Python using SciPy.
modules.vivaQuestions: What is the relationship between Type I error (alpha) and Type II error (beta) in statistical hypothesis testing?

department: School of Engineering & Technology - Applied Sciences
description: Physical principles underlying modern microelectronics and quantum computing: wave-particle duality, Schrodinger equation, energy band theory, p-n junction physics, and qubit superposition.

modules.moduleTitle: Wave Mechanics & Quantum Postulates
modules.topics: De Broglie hypothesis, Heisenberg uncertainty principle, wave packet, Time-dependent and time-independent Schrodinger equation, Particle in a 1D potential well, Quantum tunneling.
modules.practicalLabWork: Simulation of quantum wave packets tunneling through finite potential barriers.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain the physical mechanism of quantum tunneling and its impact on sub-3nm transistor leakage.

modules.moduleTitle: Semiconductor Band Theory & Fermi Energy
modules.topics: Kronig-Penney model, Brillouin zones, Direct vs Indirect bandgap semiconductors, Intrinsic and extrinsic carrier concentrations, Fermi-Dirac statistics, Fermi energy level temperature dependence.
modules.practicalLabWork: Hall effect measurement to determine semiconductor carrier type and mobility.
modules.vivaQuestions: Why do direct bandgap semiconductors emit light efficiently whereas indirect bandgap semiconductors require phonon assistance?

modules.moduleTitle: Junction Physics & Optoelectronics
modules.topics: p-n junction under equilibrium and bias, Depletion region width, Built-in potential, I-V characteristics, Zener and avalanche breakdown, Photodiodes, Solar cells, LEDs and semiconductor lasers.
modules.practicalLabWork: V-I characterization of silicon diode, Zener diode, and laser diode threshold currents.
modules.vivaQuestions: Differentiate between Zener breakdown and Avalanche breakdown in heavily doped junctions.

modules.moduleTitle: Nanomaterials & Quantum Wells
modules.topics: Quantum confinement, Quantum wells, Quantum wires, Quantum dots, 2D materials (Graphene, MoS2), Carbon nanotubes, Density of states in low-dimensional systems.
modules.practicalLabWork: Spectroscopic measurement of quantum dot emission spectra vs nanoparticle size.
modules.vivaQuestions: How does the density of states function change from bulk 3D material to 0D quantum dots?

modules.moduleTitle: Foundations of Quantum Information & Qubits
modules.topics: Bloch sphere representation, Qubit states, Quantum superposition, Quantum entanglement, Bell states, Quantum logic gates (Pauli X, Y, Z, Hadamard, CNOT), No-cloning theorem.
modules.practicalLabWork: Qiskit quantum circuit simulator: Bell state preparation and entanglement measurement.
modules.vivaQuestions: State the No-Cloning Theorem and explain why quantum states cannot be copied like classical bits.

description: Foundational data structures, abstract data types, asymptotic complexity analysis (Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta), balanced search trees, graph algorithms, and dynamic programming.

modules.moduleTitle: Asymptotic Complexity, Arrays & Linked Structures
modules.topics: Asymptotic analysis: Big-O, Omega, Theta, Master Theorem, Amortized complexity, Dynamic arrays, Singly, doubly, and circular linked lists, Skip lists, Two-pointer algorithms.
modules.practicalLabWork: Implementation of generic dynamic array list and memory-efficient unrolled linked list in Java.
modules.vivaQuestions: Prove the time complexity of dynamic array resizing using the aggregate method of amortized analysis.

modules.moduleTitle: Stacks, Queues & Priority Queues
modules.topics: Stack ADT, Monotonic stack, Infix to postfix conversion, Queue ADT, Circular queue, Deque, Priority Queue ADT, Binary heaps, Heapify in O(N) time, Heapsort.
modules.practicalLabWork: Implementation of sliding window maximum using Monotonic Deque in O(N) time.
modules.vivaQuestions: Why does building a binary heap take O(N) time when inserting N elements takes O(N log N)?

modules.moduleTitle: Trees & Balanced Search Structures
modules.topics: Binary Tree traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder, Level-order), Binary Search Trees (BST), AVL Trees (Rotations: LL, RR, LR, RL), Red-Black Tree invariants, B-Trees and B+ Trees for database storage.
modules.practicalLabWork: Implementation of AVL Tree with self-balancing rotation mechanics.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain why B+ Trees are preferred over Red-Black Trees for filesystem and database disk indexing.

modules.moduleTitle: Hashing, Sets & Disjoint-Set Union (DSU)
modules.topics: Hash tables, Hash functions, Collision resolution: Chaining vs Open Addressing, Universal hashing, Bloom filters, Union-Find with path compression.
modules.practicalLabWork: Building a high-throughput Robin Hood hashing table with linear probing.
modules.vivaQuestions: How does path compression combined with union by rank reduce Disjoint-Set operations to near-constant inverse Ackermann time?

modules.moduleTitle: Graph Algorithms & Dynamic Programming
modules.topics: Graph representations, BFS, DFS, Topological sort, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall, Prim's & Kruskal's MST, DP: 0/1 Knapsack, LCS, LIS.
modules.practicalLabWork: Dijkstra's shortest path implementation with Fibonacci heap priority queue.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain the conditions under which Dijkstra's algorithm fails and Bellman-Ford must be employed.

description: Advanced modern Java 21: Virtual Threads (Project Loom), Pattern Matching, Records, Sealed Classes, Functional Interfaces, Stream API, Concurrency, and JVM Garbage Collection internals.

modules.moduleTitle: Modern Java 21 Language Innovations
modules.topics: Records, Sealed interfaces, Pattern matching for switch, Record patterns, String templates, Scoped values, Sequenced collections, Modern memory layouts.
modules.practicalLabWork: Refactoring legacy JavaBean DTO hierarchies into immutable Java 21 Records and Sealed class trees.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain how Sealed Classes improve type safety and enable exhaustive pattern matching without default clauses.

modules.moduleTitle: Functional Programming & Stream API
modules.topics: Lambda calculus, Functional interfaces (Function, Predicate, Consumer, Supplier), Stream creation, intermediate vs terminal operations, Parallel streams, Custom Collectors, Spliterators.
modules.practicalLabWork: Building high-throughput data pipelines using custom Stream Collectors and groupingBy operations.
modules.vivaQuestions: Why should parallel streams be avoided for I/O-bound tasks in standard ForkJoinPool configurations?

modules.moduleTitle: Virtual Threads & Concurrency (Project Loom)
modules.topics: Platform threads vs Virtual threads, Continuation-based coroutines, Thread carrier model, Eliminating reactive callback hell, Structured Concurrency, ScopedValue vs ThreadLocal.
modules.practicalLabWork: Benchmarking 100,000 concurrent HTTP requests using Java 21 VirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor.
modules.vivaQuestions: How do Virtual Threads decouple thread creation from OS kernel threads without incurring pinning issues?

modules.moduleTitle: Advanced I/O, NIO.2 & Network Sockets
modules.topics: Java NIO.2, ByteBuffer, Channels, Selectors, Asynchronous file channels, Non-blocking network sockets, Serialization vs binary protocols (Protobuf, FlatBuffers).
modules.practicalLabWork: Writing a non-blocking TCP chat server using Java NIO Selectors and ByteBuffers.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain the role of the Selector component in Java NIO and how it allows a single thread to manage thousands of open sockets.

modules.moduleTitle: JVM Architecture, Classloaders & Garbage Collection
modules.topics: JVM memory layout (Heap, Metaspace, Stack), ClassLoader hierarchy, Garbage collection algorithms (Serial, Parallel, G1, ZGC, Shenandoah), JIT compilation (C1, C2), Bytecode analysis.
modules.practicalLabWork: Profiling JVM heap dumps, memory leaks, and GC pause times using VisualVM and JConsole.
modules.vivaQuestions: How does the Z Garbage Collector (ZGC) achieve sub-millisecond maximum pause times regardless of heap size?

description: Relational data modeling, advanced SQL, relational algebra, functional dependencies, normal forms (1NF to BCNF), ACID transaction concurrency, WAL, and index optimization.

modules.moduleTitle: Relational Algebra & Conceptual Modeling
modules.topics: Entity-Relationship (ER) model, Extended ER, Relational model concepts, Relational algebra operators: Select, Project, Join, Tuple relational calculus.
modules.practicalLabWork: Designing normalized ER schemas in dbdiagram.io and translating to DDL schema scripts.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain the difference between Tuple Relational Calculus and Relational Algebra in formal database theory.

modules.moduleTitle: Advanced SQL, Window Functions & Triggers
modules.topics: Complex joins, Correlated subqueries, Window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG), CTEs, Recursive CTEs, Stored procedures, Triggers.
modules.practicalLabWork: Writing analytical SQL queries using window functions and recursive CTEs for hierarchical tree traversal.
modules.vivaQuestions: Differentiate between RANK() and DENSE_RANK() window functions when duplicate values occur.

modules.moduleTitle: Functional Dependencies & Normalization
modules.topics: Functional dependencies, Armstrong's axioms, Closure of attributes, Canonical cover, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, Dependency preservation, Lossless-join decomposition.
modules.practicalLabWork: Algorithmic verification of functional dependency closures and 3NF decomposition in Python.
modules.vivaQuestions: Prove that any relation with two attributes is always in BCNF.

modules.moduleTitle: ACID Transactions & Concurrency Control
modules.topics: ACID properties, Transaction states, Schedule serializability, Lock-based protocols (2PL, Strict 2PL), Deadlock prevention, MVCC.
modules.practicalLabWork: Demonstrating dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads across isolation levels in PostgreSQL.
modules.vivaQuestions: How does Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) eliminate read-write locking contention in modern databases?

modules.moduleTitle: Storage Engine, Indexing & Query Optimization
modules.topics: File organization, Clustered vs Non-clustered indexing, B+ Tree index structures, Hash indexes, Query processing pipeline, EXPLAIN plan analysis.
modules.practicalLabWork: Analyzing and optimizing slow queries using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, composite indexes, and partial indexes.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain the structural mechanics of a B+ Tree index insertion when a leaf node overflows.

department: School of Engineering & Technology - Cloud Track
description: Enterprise distributed systems: 12-factor apps, Spring Boot 3 microservices, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, Service Mesh (Istio), API Gateway, Distributed Tracing, and Kafka event streaming.

modules.moduleTitle: Microservices Principles & Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
modules.topics: Monolith to microservices decomposition, 12-factor application methodology, Domain-Driven Design (Bounded contexts, Aggregates), Synchronous REST vs Asynchronous event streams.
modules.practicalLabWork: Decomposing an e-commerce monolithic application into Spring Boot 3 decoupled microservices.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain how Bounded Contexts in Domain-Driven Design prevent shared-database anti-patterns in microservices.

modules.moduleTitle: Docker Containerization & Multi-Stage Builds
modules.topics: Linux namespaces, cgroups, Union file systems, Docker engine architecture, Writing production Dockerfiles, Multi-stage builds, Distroless images.
modules.practicalLabWork: Building an optimized multi-stage Distroless Docker image for a Spring Boot 3 Java 21 microservice.
modules.vivaQuestions: How do Linux cgroups and namespaces provide isolation without running a separate operating system kernel?

modules.moduleTitle: Kubernetes Cluster Orchestration & Helm
modules.topics: Kubernetes architecture, Pods, Deployments, ReplicaSets, Services, Ingress controllers, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Helm chart packaging.
modules.practicalLabWork: Deploying a highly available 3-node microservice cluster on Minikube with Helm charts and zero-downtime rolling updates.
modules.vivaQuestions: Walk through how Kubernetes kube-proxy manages iptables / IPVS rules to route service traffic to live pods.

modules.moduleTitle: Resilience, Circuit Breakers & Service Mesh
modules.topics: Resilience4j circuit breakers, Retry, Rate limiter, Bulkhead patterns, Service discovery (Consul / Eureka), Service Mesh architecture (Istio Envoy sidecar), Mutual TLS.
modules.practicalLabWork: Implementing Resilience4j circuit breakers and canary routing with Istio Envoy sidecars.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain the state transitions of a Circuit Breaker (Closed, Open, Half-Open) during downstream failure.

modules.moduleTitle: Observability, Distributed Tracing & Chaos Engineering
modules.topics: Metrics (Prometheus), Logs (ELK / Loki), Traces (OpenTelemetry, Zipkin, Jaeger), Grafana dashboards, Chaos engineering principles.
modules.practicalLabWork: Instrumenting Spring Boot microservices with OpenTelemetry distributed trace headers across HTTP calls.
modules.vivaQuestions: How do W3C Trace Context headers (traceparent, tracestate) propagate correlation IDs through microservice hops?

courseTitle: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning & Deep Learning
department: School of Engineering & Technology - AI Track
description: Modern AI/ML engineering: Supervised & unsupervised learning, gradient descent mathematics, PyTorch deep neural networks, CNNs, Transformers, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with LLMs.

modules.moduleTitle: Foundations of Machine Learning & Optimization
modules.topics: Supervised vs Unsupervised learning, Linear regression, Logistic regression, Cost functions, Gradient Descent, Regularization (L1 Lasso, L2 Ridge), Bias-Variance tradeoff.
modules.practicalLabWork: Implementing Gradient Descent optimization from scratch in NumPy with vectorization.
modules.vivaQuestions: Derive the weight update rule for Logistic Regression using cross-entropy loss and gradient descent.

modules.moduleTitle: Ensemble Learning & Feature Engineering
modules.topics: Decision trees, Information gain, Gini impurity, Bagging vs Boosting, Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM, Feature scaling, Imputation, PCA, t-SNE.
modules.practicalLabWork: Building and hyperparameter-tuning an XGBoost model with cross-validation pipelines in Scikit-Learn.
modules.vivaQuestions: Why are ensemble algorithms like Random Forest inherently resistant to overfitting compared to single decision trees?

modules.moduleTitle: Deep Neural Networks & Backpropagation (PyTorch)
modules.topics: Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP), Activation functions (ReLU, GELU, Sigmoid), Backpropagation calculus, PyTorch autograd engine, Dropout, Batch Normalization.
modules.practicalLabWork: Building a deep neural network in PyTorch with custom training loops, validation loss checkpoints, and early stopping.
modules.vivaQuestions: Mathematically demonstrate why the Vanishing Gradient problem occurs when using Sigmoid activations in deep networks.

modules.moduleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) & Computer Vision
modules.topics: Convolution operations, Stride, Padding, Pooling, Receptive field, ResNet, MobileNet, YOLO concepts, Image segmentation.
modules.practicalLabWork: Training a PyTorch ResNet-18 model with transfer learning for automated medical image classification.
modules.vivaQuestions: Why do residual skip connections in ResNet enable the training of networks with over 150 layers without gradient degradation?

modules.moduleTitle: Transformers, Attention & Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
modules.topics: Scaled Dot-Product Attention, Multi-Head Self-Attention, Transformer architecture, BERT vs GPT, Vector embeddings, ChromaDB, RAG pipelines.

description: From engineering lab to market validation: Lean startup methodology, customer discovery, minimum viable product (MVP), business model canvas, cap table math, seed fundraising, and pitch decks.

modules.moduleTitle: Opportunity Recognition & Ideation
modules.topics: Identifying market friction, Problem-Solution fit, Value proposition design, Design thinking methodologies, Blue Ocean Strategy, Competitive moat analysis.
modules.practicalLabWork: Conducting 10 customer discovery interviews and drafting a Value Proposition Canvas for a deep-tech startup.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain the difference between Problem-Solution fit and Product-Market fit in early-stage ventures.

modules.moduleTitle: Lean Startup & Minimum Viable Product (MVP)
modules.topics: Build-Measure-Learn feedback loop, Types of MVPs, Pivot strategies, Unit economics (CAC, LTV).
modules.practicalLabWork: Calculating Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Lifetime Value (LTV) for a B2B SaaS subscription model.
modules.vivaQuestions: Why is an LTV/CAC ratio of greater than 3:1 considered the benchmark for sustainable venture growth?

modules.moduleTitle: Business Models & Financial Projections
modules.topics: Business Model Canvas (BMC), Revenue models, Cost structure, Pro-forma financial statements, Burn rate, Runway calculations.
modules.practicalLabWork: Constructing a 3-year dynamic financial model and runway calculator in Excel/Google Sheets.
modules.vivaQuestions: Walk through the components of the Business Model Canvas and explain how cost structure ties into key resources.

modules.moduleTitle: Fundraising, Term Sheets & Pitching
modules.topics: Venture capital ecosystem (Angel, Seed, Series A), SAFE notes vs Convertible notes, Cap table dilution modeling, Term sheet negotiation.
modules.practicalLabWork: Simulating a Cap Table dilution model across Seed and Series A financing rounds.
modules.vivaQuestions: What is the difference between Pre-Money and Post-Money valuation when calculating investor equity percentage?

courseTitle: Centurion Action Learning & Production Skill Certification
description: Hands-on industry action learning: Real-world micro-factory production tasks, Sector Skill Council (SSC) industry certification, live client deliverables, and peer code quality benchmarking.

modules.moduleTitle: Action Learning Methodology & Problem Framing
modules.topics: Centurion Action Learning framework, Industrial problem statement identification, Root cause analysis, Technical feasibility study, Project charter generation.
modules.practicalLabWork: Formulating a production-grade problem charter with measurable SLA deliverables for an enterprise sponsor.
modules.vivaQuestions: How does the Action Learning methodology differ from traditional simulated classroom projects?

modules.moduleTitle: Production-Grade Implementation & Quality Assurance
modules.topics: Clean Code standards, Static code analysis (SonarQube), Automated unit testing (>80% coverage), Integration testing, CI/CD pipeline automation.
modules.practicalLabWork: Setting up an automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline enforcing SonarQube quality gates.
modules.vivaQuestions: What metrics define a production Quality Gate in automated CI/CD pipelines?

modules.moduleTitle: Industry Standard Skill Certification (SSC / ASDC)
modules.topics: National Occupational Standards (NOS), Qualification Packs (QP), Theoretical and practical skill competency evaluation under Sector Skill Councils.
modules.practicalLabWork: Undergoing formal National Occupational Standards practical assessment for Full-Stack / Cloud competency.
modules.vivaQuestions: Explain how Qualification Packs (QP) map to industry-certified employability skills.

modules.moduleTitle: Client Delivery & Technical Retrospective
modules.topics: User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Technical handoff documentation, Production deployment verification, Post-delivery sprint retrospective.
modules.practicalLabWork: Executing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) signoff with structured acceptance criteria matrix.
modules.vivaQuestions: What is the primary objective of a Sprint Retrospective in agile production engineering?
